_comment: Ars Zero glyph-school overrides. Everything not listed here resolves from the school
metadata the glyph declares (Geometrize -> earth -> nature, Push -> air -> lightning,
the arcane shield / voxel / beam / convergence / enlarge / zero-gravity effects ->
manipulation -> ender). The forms and augments declare no school and fall to generic.
Conjure Blight declares Necromancy, which has no Iron's counterpart in the translation
table, so it is placed explicitly. The four control-flow glyphs also declare Manipulation,
but they only steer a Spell Staff's phases and are not a spell effect in their own right,
so they are kept out of Ender affinity and progression.
Ars Zero registers its glyphs without the glyph_ prefix Ars Nouveau uses for its own
(ars_zero:anchor_effect, not ars_zero:glyph_anchor_effect); the glyph_ form is only its
